'''The Outer Rim tournament reports''' are the Star Wars CCG tournament reports on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]], the Las Vegas GeoCities fan site. The SWCCG index linked an Articles section next to ratings, Ask The Senate, Ask Yoda, and Las Vegas tournament listings.<ref name="swidx">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/SWindexhome.htm SW Alliance Jump Station], The Outer Rim. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010806052101/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/SWindexhome.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

The Worlds Day 1 and Day 2 reports are the same text [[Tim Guzman]] posted on DeckTech as Info Broker. Those articles already exist.
